name: MKQA: Multilingual Knowledge Questions & Answers
description: MKQA is an open-domain multilingual question-answering benchmark comprising 10,000 question-answer pairs aligned across 26 typologically diverse languages (260,000 query-answer pairs total). Sourced from the Natural Questions dataset and manually translated by human translators, MKQA evaluates knowledge retrieval and answering independent of English passage bias, featuring independent human-curated language-specific answer spans and long/short answer types.
